primarySources.finding: CI install --check rejects incompatible versions; --fix changes packages.
EXPO_OFFLINE avoids applicable network requests; EXPO_NO_DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION disables checks and is excluded from the chosen policy.

installedObservation.finding: Remote lookup runs only when EXPO_OFFLINE is false; otherwise it reads installed expo/bundledNativeModules.json. Missing local map rejects rather than inventing compatibility.
installedObservation.boundary: Source directly inspected before the proposed patch upgrade; installed-source proof after root update requires its own exact version/hash and checks.

chosenPolicy.requiredCompatibility: CI=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx --no-install expo install --check from apps/mobile
chosenPolicy.requiredScope: Installed lockfile-backed Expo cohort and its bundled compatibility map, retaining validation.
chosenPolicy.updateDiscovery: Daily ONLINE audit/outdated/Expo recommendations and unchanged weekly proposals.
chosenPolicy.releaseProcess: Review coherent stable patches, exact-lock install, installed security/ownership guards, current source/browser and protected CI.

candidatePatchProposal.source: Coordinator verified published stable npm metadata; child did not install or independently claim runtime support.
candidatePatchProposal.status: Root owns install/pipeline changes and qualification.

boundary: Current primary docs/source observations support the policy. They do not prove upgraded package runtime/native support, hosted execution, a completed R17 aggregate or a passing browser/CI run.
